citations.quote: I am writing to ask for your help contesting the termination of my lease for the 3.5-room flat at Rosenstrasse 38 in Baden.
The flat is our family home: my husband lives there with me.
The landlord is ending the tenancy because of unpaid rent. He states that the arrears amount to about CHF 5,280.
I dispute that the termination is justified on this basis, and I believe it is retaliation.
Earlier this year I complained in writing about defects in the flat, including damp in the bathroom and a faulty heating valve, and I also challenged the rent increase.

plan.because: Needed to verify the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The customer reports a termination, but the original notice and its form contents are missing. Receipt is presumed for routing under the silence policy.
The recipient and delivery date are needed urgently to assess the challenge deadline.
Needed to verify the agreed notice period and relevant termination dates.
The reported arrears reason needs the landlord's original stated ground and factual basis.
The customer reports that the flat is the family home; separate spouse notice and service need checking.
Arrears are reported as the termination ground; the cure period and warning need verification.
Needed to assess the claimed arrears, payments and balance.
The customer alleges retaliation after written defect complaints and a rent-increase challenge.
Extension is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning under the silence policy.
This is optional in the admitted process.

questions: Did you receive a termination notice? If so, on what date and how was it delivered? Please provide the notice and delivery evidence urgently so the challenge deadline can be assessed.
Did your husband receive a separate notice? If so, please provide it and any delivery evidence.
Please provide the requested lease, arrears warning, rent and payment records, and your earlier written complaints and rent-increase challenge.
Please confirm the stated termination date and provide any separate written explanation of the landlord's reason.
